title: Up to 54% off Japan eSIM Plans: 10GB $9.95, 14-Days Unlimited Data $35.95 (down from $60.95) @ The SIM Shop
body:
Deal: Up to 54% off Japan eSIM Plans: 10GB $9.95, 14-Days Unlimited Data $35.95 (down from $60.95) @ The SIM Shop

[chansc] Does the full speed unlimited plan have speed or data limit for hotspot? Can I also scan the activation QR code before my trip? Once purchased, when do I have to activate the eSIM?
[auspicious-banana] hey hey! there are two types of unlimited plans and the hotspot allowance is labelled on them on the product page when you select a plan - there’s either a fully unlimited hotspot option, or the set GB hotspot allowance for the 10MB/s limited plan. Yes you 100% can activate your sim before leaving, however after a lot of travel I’ve found that you never encounter activation issues if you wait until you arrive and activate on airport wifi - I’d strongly suggest activating once you arrive. And once you purchase, you have up to 180 days to activate. Feel free to let me know if you have any other questions too, and happy travels:)

[deal4life] I'm visiting for 10.5 days and my return flight is on 11th day afternoon.. do I need to buy 15 Days plans or I can survive with 10 Days plan and being with no internet for half day?
[shrapse] I think that is a question you need to ask yourself and not other people.
[deal4life] first time visiting Japan, need to know if I can survive.. anyways.. will workout deal with multiple plans..
[Shenannigoat] Are you flying in late? If you’re heading straight to a hotel, just activate it on your first full day and use hotel wifi in the meantime.
[SirFrankGrimes] @Shenannigoat: Yeah, you can absolutely survive with internet for 1/2 a day. Or, just get a free or $1 24-hour eSIM online from another provider
[deal4life] @SirFrankGrimes: that's great, this is advise I was looking for.. cool thanks..
[sigplay] I believe there's a few free or low cost 1day sims in Klook so maybe that will get you covered
[1cent2much] Can the activation be delayed? My trip is 4-14 Jan.
[auspicious-banana] absolutely, activation can be delayed up to 12 months after purchase :)
[AsukaST] Very doggy product description.
Your 3/5/7/10 days plan only offer "Up to 10Mbps" speed, not even "at least 10Mbps".
That's 3.5G HSDPA speed but you're trying to claim it's 4G/5G speed.
No way I will get a sim with speed lower than 21Mbps in 2026.
Your 30 days plan doesn't say the actual speed at all, only 4G/5G which is meaningless.
I would avoid and buy a local esim on Amazon JP instead.
[Shenannigoat] Have you had experience with any of these?
[AsukaST] In the past 10+ years I always buy local sim cards on Amazon JP,
and get it shipped to my hotel, or pick up at Lawson convenient store at the airport.
but I've never get an e-sim as my phone didn't support.
Pick something with 50+ good reviews and it should be fine.
The good news is, if your e-sim is really slow, just make a complaint to Amazon chat and they will refund you.
[auspicious-banana] really appreciate the feedback. The 3/5/7/10 days plans are a cheaper alternative to the uncapped speed unlimited plans.
The cheaper plans still uses the 4G/5G networks, the speed is just capped by the providers as per the cheaper cost.
The 30 days plan uses uncapped speed as per the 4G and 5G networks (like other eSim plans).
Hope this helps clarify :)
[movieman] Suggest comparing prices with Trip.com
Currently using it in Japan, and works great.
[auspicious-banana] awesome thanks man! Hope your having a great trip :)
[hoodchild] Any 22 day plans? We’re not going until March next year, can we purchase now for then?
[auspicious-banana] unfortunately there is only 21 and 26 day plans offered :( . You can purchase and then activate anytime up to 12 months after purchase.
